props.description: The brand pattern. Defaults to `strata`, the primary.
props.name: pattern

props.description: The steel dots' colour, a theme token name read as `--color-<name>`. Defaults to `accent`.
props.name: front

props.description: The ground's colour, a theme token name. Defaults to `background`.
props.name: back

props.description: The engine glow's colour (the champagne core), a theme token name. Defaults to `core`.
props.name: core

props.description: One dither cell in CSS pixels: 2 to 8 for `dots`, 2 to 24 for `glyphs`. Defaults to 4.
props.name: pixelSize

props.description:
How a lit cell is drawn: `dots`, a square of its colour, or `glyphs`, a code character in the mono font at the cell
size. Defaults to `dots`.
props.name: mode

props.description: The characters `glyphs` draws from. Defaults to `{}[]()<>/=+*#;`.
props.name: glyphs

props.description:
Where the core glow (the sun) sits, as fractions of the art's width from the inline start and of its height, so in
right-to-left it follows the mirrored layout. Defaults to the pattern's own.
props.name: sun

props.description: How fast the art drifts on real time; 0 is still. Defaults to 1, and is 0 whenever motion is reduced.
props.name: speed

props.description:
The kit's poster image for this pattern, one for both schemes or one per scheme (`{ light, dark }`; dark first):
what the edge render, a page without script and print show,
under the canvas until it draws.
props.name: poster
props.type: string | { readonly light: string; readonly dark: string; }

props.description: A fade over the art: `radial` toward the edges, `bottom` or `top` toward that side. Defaults to `none`.
props.name: mask

props.description: Styles the wrapper; give it a size, since the art fills it.
props.name: className
